name: Expired Reset Pass Link
description: Adds the one-time password-reset link timeout setting to the core user account settings form.
project_description: Expired Reset Pass Link is a small UI-only helper in the User package that surfaces Drupal core's existing user.settings:password_reset_timeout value as an editable field on the account settings form at /admin/config/people/accounts. Core already uses password_reset_timeout to decide how long a one-time login (password reset) link stays valid, but core exposes no admin UI for it; this module adds a 'Password Link Reset Timeout' number field (in seconds, minimum 1, maximum 31536000 = one year, default 86400 = 24 hours) so a site administrator can adjust that lifetime without editing settings.php. It provides no routes, permissions, services (beyond the hook class), entities, plugins or config schema of its own, and does not alter core's token generation or validation.
